plan.name: Strategy 2: Prioritize Target Location First
plan.strategy: Check the garbagecan first to confirm if the tomato is already there. If not, search for the tomato in likely locations and heat it before placing it in the garbagecan.
steps: Check the garbagecan to see if the tomato is already present and hot.
If not, search for the tomato in the fridge, countertops, and cabinets.
Heat the tomato in the microwave if it is not already hot.
Place the hot tomato in the garbagecan.
